punchline: Nir Eyal, who writes about distraction, glanced at his phone while his daughter chose a superpower, and when he looked up she was gone.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal asked his young daughter which superpower she would choose. While she thought, he checked his phone, and when he looked up she had left the room. That moment pushed him to ask why we escape into screens at all. His answer in Indistractable is not weak willpower but the discomfort we want to get away from.
